title: Umonde Womphefumlo Obandezelekileyo
intro: Kwiingxelo zembali, kukho umntu ogama lakhe lithetha ukunyamezela. Lo mntu wavavanywa ngokulahlekelwa yiyo yonke intuthuzelo yehlabathi, kodwa wahlala engumkhonzi ozinikeleyo woMdali. Kwiminyaka yobunzima nokugula komzimba, intliziyo yalo mphefumlo yahlala inamathele elukholweni, inika isibane sethemba kubo bonke abajongene nobunzima.
clues: Ndandingumkhonzi ozinikeleyo ka-Allah, ndisikelelwe ngobutyebi obuninzi, abantwana abaninzi, nempilo entle.
Ubomi bam batshintsha xa ndahluthwa ubutyebi bam nosapho lwam, ndasala ndingenanto ngaphandle kokholo lwam.
Ndandigula kakhulu, ndinesifo esibuhlungu nesihlala ixesha elide, esasivavanya imida yokunyamezela komntu.
Kuyo yonke imbandezelo yam, andizange ndivume ukukhalaza ngeNkosi yam, nangona utshaba lwaluzama ukundikhokelela ekuphelelweni lithemba.
Ekugqibeleni ndathi ndakubiza iNkosi yam, andizange ndicele ubutyebi, kodwa ndavuma nje ukuba ubunzima bundichukumisile.
Ndaxelelwa ukuba ndibethe umhlaba ngonyawo lwam, kwaye kuwo kwaphuma umthombo wamanzi abandayo ukuphilisa umzimba wam nokuphelisa unxano lwam.
arabic: ٱرْكُضْ بِرِجْلِكَ ۖ هَـٰذَا مُغْتَسَلٌۢ بَارِدٌۭ وَشَرَابٌۭ
verse: [So he was told], "Strike [the ground] with your foot; this is a [spring for a] cool bath and drink." (38:42)
